configuration.contextDisplay.description: Context indicator style. Also available in the chat commands menu.
configuration.contextDisplay.ring: Smaller ring without numbers; details remain in the tooltip.
extension.description: Codex CLI in VS Code: chat tabs, images, project context and queued follow-ups. Independent extension with English and Russian UI.
command.beside: Rundix: New session to the side
command.newWindow: Rundix: New session in a separate window
configuration.controlMotion.description: Animate the reasoning slider and switches. This setting affects only Rundix controls.
configuration.controlMotion.auto: Follow the system preference for reduced motion.
configuration.controlMotion.on: Always slide controls smoothly, even when reduced motion is enabled.
configuration.mcpAccessMode.description: Access mode for new chats created by Claude Code MCP tasks. Applies when a task's chat is created; continuations keep the chat's current mode. Only your user settings are used, never workspace settings. **Full access** lets Codex change files and use the network outside the project without asking.
configuration.mcpAccessMode.workspace: Ask for permission: changes inside the project, extended actions need approval (default).
configuration.mcpAccessMode.manual: Manual: read without changes; writing needs approval.
configuration.mcpAccessMode.auto: Approve for me: Codex's automatic review answers permission requests.
configuration.mcpAccessMode.full: Full access: files and network, including actions outside the project, without approval requests.
configuration.mcpThreadConfig.descriptio: Codex configuration overrides applied only to chats created by Claude Code MCP tasks, sent as the per-thread `config` of `thread/start` and `thread/resume` (same keys as `~/.codex/config.toml`). For example, disable helper MCP servers or plugins that you do not need in unattended tasks and that keep the task folder in use. Only user settings are read.
configuration.mcpMaxParallelTasks.descri: How many Claude Code MCP tasks may run Codex turns at the same time (1–5). Tasks for the same project or git worktree always run one after another; use separate worktrees for parallel work.
configuration.activityMotion.description: Animate the live activity indicator and rotate its phrases at the end of the conversation.
configuration.activityMotion.auto: Follow the system preference for reduced motion.
configuration.activityMotion.on: Enable activity animation even when reduced motion is enabled.
configuration.activityMotion.off: Keep the activity indicator and its phrase still.
command.mcpConnectPool: Rundix: Connect MCP to account pool
command.mcpStart: Rundix: Start MCP bridge and show Claude configuration
